Overview

Newcastle upon Tyne is a city in England with a population of 302,000. A vibrant northern city on the Tyne, famous for its Georgian architecture, legendary nightlife, the Tyne Bridge, and friendly Geordie culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
